subject: Partner alignment: region-specific retention & deletion runbook (AWS/GCP/Azure)
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@cloudfolio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Region mapping + retention/deletion questions for marketplace integration

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As Cloudfolio progresses through the marketplace listing, our security and operations teams asked for a concise runbook that shows how residency, retention, and deletion will be handled across the three major clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure).

Specific asks from the questionnaire attached:
- For each region we need the default retention TTL for generated data and embeddings, and where the primary KV/cache is stored.
- Exact deletion flow (API call, async job, retention TTL enforcement) and expected latency to fully delete customer data.
- Any scenarios where data may leave the requested geography (e.g., for backups, replication, or analytics) and mitigation controls.
- Evidence we can include in our SOC/third-party review (audit logs, KMS key ids, config snapshots).

Can you share a short playbook or schedule a 60-minute alignment call with ops/security + your partner team? We’d like the runbook to be included in Cloudfolio’s vendor pack.

I attached Cloudfolio_Security_Questions.pdf with the specific fields they want populated. Proposed attendees: Emily (security), Jake (engineering), and their procurement lead (TBD).

Thanks — appreciate it.

Emily Chen
Head of Platform Security
Cloudfolio

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily@cloudfolio.com>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@cloudfolio.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Region mapping + retention/deletion questions for marketplace integration

Hi Emily — thanks for sending this over and for the clear checklist.

Short answer: we can provide a single playbook that maps retention and deletion semantics to AWS/GCP/Azure region groups, plus evidence artifacts (audit logs, KMS alias list, and deletion job run records). I attached a first-pass retention matrix (redwood-region-retention-matrix-v0.xlsx) that maps our default TTLs and the delete pathway we typically use for marketplace partners.

Proposed next steps:
1) 60-minute alignment call — suggested time slots: Thu 11/19 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 11/20 08:00–09:00 PT. We’ll include engineering (Ben), partner ops (me), and security (Neha).
2) I’ll circulate a draft playbook and an agenda before the call (what goes into the vendor pack, where to place the evidence).
3) If Cloudfolio needs region-locking (hard region pinning), we’ll surface the options and the expected variance in latency/cost.

A couple of clarifications for your team to confirm before the call:
- Are you asking for per-customer retention overrides (yes/no)? That changes the delete flow slightly.
- Do you require hard-only residency (no cross-region backups) for any accounts? If so, please flag which accounts; we have distinct processes and SLA implications.

I’ll coordinate with Ben and Neha to pull the specific audit artifacts.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-region-retention-matrix-v0.xlsx (spreadsheet, 6 sheets)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Region mapping + retention/deletion questions for marketplace integration

Mina / Neha — quick internal note while I draft the playbook.

I sketched a short agenda and the deletion pathways we should walk Cloudfolio through during the call. See the outline attached (sync-playbook-outline.md). Highlights:
- Default retention: 30 days for ephemeral prompt logs, 365 days for customer-owned embeddings (configurable per contract).
- Deletion pathway: 1) API request or console request triggers deletion ticket; 2) async GC job enqueues records for region-local purge; 3) KV cache and model prefix caches are invalidated immediately, underlying storage object deletion runs within 24–72 hours depending on cloud provider and lifecycle settings.
- Backups: We replicate metadata-only backups to a secondary region for resilience by default; we can opt out for strict region-locking customers but that requires a Dedicated/Private deployment or Marketplace exception.
- Evidence: audit.log export (JSONL), KMS alias manifest, and deletion job run ids (we keep these for 13 months under enterprise contracts).

Open questions for the workshop:
- Confirm if Cloudfolio needs per-customer TTL overrides.
- Confirm whether secondary backups are acceptable with encryption-in-transit and customer-managed keys.

I’ll attach this as the pre-read. We should finalize the matrix values in the spreadsheet and then send a short version to Cloudfolio.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sync-playbook-outline.md

I also dropped the working playbook materials into a shared folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-cloudfolio-playbook — please review the v0 spreadsheet and add comments.

Best,
